metadata.question: Did the burn scar area near Hermit Park in Santa Fe, New Mexico (35.759, 105.503), increase between April 19, 2022, and April 23, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Hermit Park, Santa Fe, NM (35.759, -105.503) - note I'll use negative longitude for western hemisphere - Time: Two specific dates - April 19, 2022 and April 23, 2022 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for burn scar detection (better resolution than Landsat), or Landsat 8/9 as fallback - Use NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) = (NIR - SWIR2)/(NIR + SWIR2) to detect burn scars 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds to get valid burn scar readings - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking - For Landsat, use QA_PIXEL band 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid burn scar area could be 0 (no burn) or positive values - Check if images exist for both dates (C1) - Check if valid pixels remain after masking (C2) - Check if NBR calculation produces valid results (C3) - Compare burn scar area between the two dates - if area increased, answer A; if decreased or stayed same, answer B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-105.503, 35.759]); const region = point.buffer(5000); // 5km radius around the point const date1Start = '2022-04-19'; const date1End = '2022-04-20'; const date2Start = '2022-04-23'; const date2End = '2022-04-24'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Try Sentinel-2 first let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 19 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`April 23 Images: ${size2}`); // Fallback to Landsat 8/9 if Sentinel-2 not available if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')) .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End); col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')) .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End); const ls_size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const ls_size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat April 19: ${ls_size1}, April 23: ${ls_size2}`); if (ls_size1 === 0 || ls_size2 === 0) { console.log('No data available for both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function calculateNBR(image) { const nir = image.select('B8'); const swir2 = image.select('B12'); return nir.subtract(swir2).divide(nir.add(swir2)).rename('NBR'); } const img1 = maskS2clouds(col1.first()); const img2 = maskS2clouds(col2.first()); const nbr1 = calculateNBR(img1); const nbr2 = calculateNBR(img2); // Check for valid pixels const count1 = await nbr1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const count2 = await nbr2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels April 19: ${count1}, April 23: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation - Detect burn scars (NBR < 0.1 indicates burned area) const burned1 = nbr1.lt(0.1); const burned2 = nbr2.lt(0.1); const burnArea1 = await burned1.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const burnArea2 = await burned2.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (burnArea1 === null || burnArea2 === null || isNaN(burnArea1) || isNaN(burnArea2)) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const area1_km2 = (burnArea1 / 1e6).toFixed(2); const area2_km2 = (burnArea2 / 1e6).toFixed(2); console.log(`Burn scar area April 19: ${area1_km2} km²`); console.log(`Burn scar area April 23: ${area2_km2} km²`); console.log(`Change: ${(area2_km2 - area1_km2).toFixed(2)} km²`); if (burnArea2 > burnArea1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
